title: DreamCoder: Growing generalizable, interpretable knowledge with wake-sleep Bayesian program learning
venue: Transactions of the Royal Society A
relevance: Learns and transfers new symbolic library primitives from solved tasks.
non_coverage: Does not evaluate net compiler value on real tensor programs with full discovery cost.

title: Top-Down Synthesis for Library Learning
relevance: Stitch synthesizes compressive reusable abstractions from an initial DSL and explicitly measures library-learning time and memory.
non_coverage: Optimizes corpus description length rather than executed compiler outcomes.

title: LILO: Learning Interpretable Libraries by Compressing and Documenting Code
relevance: Combines LLM synthesis, Stitch compression, documentation, and held-out program-solving evaluation.
non_coverage: Uses inductive synthesis benchmarks rather than real compiler runtime and does not provide the proposed causal total-cost protocol.

title: ReGAL: Refactoring Programs to Discover Generalizable Abstractions
relevance: Learns execution-checked reusable functions by refactoring programs across several reasoning domains.
non_coverage: Does not establish real tensor-compiler value or charge an autonomous compiler tool economy.

title: Rewrite Rule Inference Using Equality Saturation
relevance: Ruler automatically infers compact sound rewrite rules and matches expert rules in an end-to-end case study.
non_coverage: Does not learn a cross-family tensor tool economy with prospective total-cost evidence.

title: Equality Saturation Theory Exploration a la Carte
relevance: Enumo provides programmable theory exploration and infers deeper rules from larger grammars.
non_coverage: Requires a supplied theory-exploration program and does not test the proposed end-to-end economic claim.

title: Equality Saturation for Tensor Graph Superoptimization
relevance: TENSAT applies equality saturation to tensor graphs and reports optimized graph speedups and lower optimization time.
non_coverage: Uses supplied substitutions rather than autonomous reusable abstraction growth.

title: Ansor: Generating High-Performance Tensor Programs for Deep Learning
relevance: Searches hierarchical tensor schedules with a learned cost model and measures real CPU and GPU workloads.
non_coverage: Its hierarchical search space and schedule transformations are engineered rather than autonomously extended.

title: Tensor Program Optimization with Probabilistic Programs
relevance: MetaSchedule supplies a modular probabilistic scheduling language and learning-driven optimization.
non_coverage: Experts grow the search space; the system does not autonomously mint verified reusable operators.

title: Optimizing Tensor Computation Graphs with Equality Saturation and Monte Carlo Tree Search
relevance: Uses MCTS to choose promising tensor rewrite actions and reports up to 11 percent inference improvement.
non_coverage: Per-instance e-graph construction does not yield the proposed persistent typed tool economy.

title: MISAAL: Synthesis-Based Automatic Generation of Efficient and Retargetable Semantics-Driven Optimizations
relevance: Automatically generates and abstracts semantics-driven rewrites offline, then evaluates real x86, Hexagon, and ARM workloads.
non_coverage: Hardware semantics remain supplied and the paper does not test post-freeze behavioral reuse with total discovery cost in the primary outcome.

title: LLM-Guided Strategy Synthesis for Scalable Equality Saturation
relevance: EggMind synthesizes reusable EqSat strategies, uses held-out cases, reports offline cost, and evaluates an XLA-based tensor compiler.
non_coverage: Uses a supplied rewrite vocabulary and cost model; reports offline cost separately rather than establishing total-cost causal library value over a prospective workload stream.

title: Is This LLM Library Learning? Evaluation Must Account For Compute and Behaviour
relevance: Shows that gains in three LLM library-learning systems often vanish under compute matching and finds missing behavioral evidence of reuse; requires equal compute and behavioral analysis.
non_coverage: It is an evaluation critique rather than a real-compiler library-learning system.

title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
relevance: Shows evaluator-guided code evolution on algorithms, mathematics, and production infrastructure.
non_coverage: Does not isolate persistent typed abstraction reuse under the proposed compiler protocol.

title: Prospective Compression in Human Abstraction Learning
relevance: Frames online library learning under uncertain future demand and distinguishes prospective from retrospective compression.
non_coverage: Studies human behavior in a visual task rather than autonomous compiler optimization.

title: Babble: Learning Better Abstractions with E-Graphs and Anti-Unification
relevance: Learns reusable functions modulo a supplied equational theory using e-graph anti-unification and includes library size in its compression objective.
non_coverage: Evaluates program compression rather than prospective total-cost value on executed tensor workloads.

title: Finding Reusable Instructions via E-Graph Anti-Unification
relevance: ISAMORE is an LLM-free end-to-end system that identifies semantically reusable custom hardware instructions from real applications and measures reuse, area, exploration time, and speedup.
non_coverage: Uses a supplied DSL, rewrite theory, profiler, and hardware cost model; its offline and per-workload discovery costs are not tested as one compute-matched post-freeze prospective stream.

title: Ghost Scientist Operator v5.1 goal closure
relevance: Prospective 18-gate real CPU tensor-program result and current claim boundary.
non_coverage: Primitive semantics and rewrite theory are supplied.

title: Ghost Scientist Operator v5.1 protocol
relevance: Frozen held-out protocol, controls, numerical bounds, and preserved v5 failure.
non_coverage: Does not test autonomous abstraction construction.

title: Round BA machine-inferred algebra tools
relevance: Machine-generated exact rewrite grammar with prospective reuse and explicit Ruler-family attribution.
non_coverage: Exact polynomial domain and proxy costs; not real tensor runtime.

title: The Closure Principle
relevance: Distinguishes true closure from budget-bounded reachability and records human-supplied generator limits.
non_coverage: Does not itself provide a v6 compiler experiment.

title: Open inner-transform forge
relevance: Shows useful certified promotion and saturation at a fixed substrate family.
non_coverage: Synthetic monomial and parity domain.

title: Execution-only novelty limit
relevance: Shows composition and relative atom promotion bottom out at the fixed opcode substrate.
non_coverage: Does not rule out useful budget-relative abstraction learning.

title: Certified menu minting
relevance: Shows bounded program-synthesized menu growth and honest within-VM claim boundary.
non_coverage: Synthetic grid predicates and relative irreducibility only.

title: Verify-learn-invent production loop
relevance: Demonstrates promote-and-reuse mechanics with persistent libraries.
non_coverage: Scripted bounded intents and no real compiler economics.
